A LETTER FOR MY LOVE

My Love,

Happy Birthday to the man who makes my ordinary days feel special. You are my favourite person, my comfort, my biggest support and my home. ❤️

Thank you for every smile, every hug, every silly moment and every memory we have made together.

If I could give you one thing, I would give you the chance to see yourself through my eyes — then you would know how precious you are to me.

You are my today, my tomorrow and my forever. ❤️

Happy Birthday, my love.

Forever yours,
Your Wife ❤️
